description: This Java class defines the 'ThingDefinitionModifiedStrategy', which handles 'ThingDefinitionModified' events within the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract strategy class and applies modifications to a 'ThingBuilder' based on the incoming event.

classes.name: ThingDefinitionModifiedStrategy
classes.description: A final class that handles 'ThingDefinitionModified' events, applying changes to the 'ThingBuilder' to update the thing's definition.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the method to handle 'ThingDefinitionModified' events by setting the new definition on the provided 'ThingBuilder'.
